questions.question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice. **

Mandeep has repaired the truck.

options.text: The truck have been repaired by Mandeep.
The truck had been repaired by Mandeep.
The truck is been repaired by Mandeep.
The truck has been repaired by Mandeep.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'The truck has been repaired by Mandeep**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the **present perfect tense**.
 
• Passive Voice sentences of Present Perfect Tense use “**has/have” along with “been” **as a helping verb with respective number nouns and pronouns.
 
• **Sentence structure**: 
 
 
• **Active: **Subject + has/have + V3 + object.
 
• **Passive: **Object + has/have + been + V3 + by + subject.
 
 
 
• Example: 
 
 
• **Active:** Reema has cooked food.
 
• **Passive**: Food has been cooked by Reema. 
 
 
 
• Thus, the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice is **option 4**. 

**Correct Passive Voice:**__ *The truck has been repaired by Mandeep.*

questions.question:
**Select the correct direct form of the given sentence.**

Mr. Sharma asked him if Maya had invited him for lunch.

options.text: Mr. Sharma said to him, "Has Maya invited you for lunch?"
Mr. Sharma said to me, "Has Maya invited you for lunch?"
Mr. Sharma said to him, "Had Maya invited us for lunch?"
Mr. Sharma said to him, "Did Maya invited us for lunch?"

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Mr. Sharma said to him, "Has Maya invited you for lunch?"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in** Indirect Speech.** As per the question we have to change it to **Direct Speech.** 
 
• The process of transformation is as follows: 
 
• **'Asked' **will be changed into **'said to'**.
 
• Comma and inverted commas will be added. 
 
• If the indirect Speech is in **Past Perfect tense 'had invited'**, the Direct Speech will be in the **Present Perfect Tense 'has invited'**.
 
• **'him' **will be changed to **'you'.**
 
• Thus, the correct direct form of the given sentence is **option 1**.

**Correct Answer:**__ *Mr. Sharma said to him, "Has Maya invited you for lunch?"*

questions.question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

The jewel thief was punished by the judge.

options.text: Punishment had been given to jewel thief.
The police had punished the jewel thief.
The judge punished the jewel thief.
Punishment was given to jewel thief.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **The judge punished the jewel thief**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the **passive voice**. We have to change the sentence into the **active form**. 

 The given sentence is written in** 'simple past tense' **form. 
 
• The sentence structure in the Simple past tense is as follows: 
 
 
• Passive: Object + was/were + V3 + by + Subject.
 
• ​**Active:** Subject + V2 + Object.
 
 
 
• **Example:**
 
 
• Passive: This beautiful necklace was brought by Renu.
 
• ** ****Active: **Renu brought this beautiful necklace.
 
 
 
• The object of the given sentence is **'The jewel thief' **and the subject of the given sentence is** 'the judge.'**
 
• So, in the active voice, the position of **‘object’ **and **‘subject’ **will be interchanged and 'by' will be removed. 
 
• Also here,** 'was punished' **will be changed into** 'punished.'**
 
• Thus, the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice is **option 3**.

**Correct Active Voice:**__ *The judge punished the jewel thief.*

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'No substitution'.**

Finally, here are a few examples __of passages and their precis__.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"No substitution"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The challenge here is to select the option that can aptly substitute the underlined portion of the sentence "Finally, here are a few examples of passages and their precis."
 
• Let's evaluate the alternatives:
 
 
• "By passages and their precis": 'By' doesn't fit the context here. The intent of the sentence is to introduce 'examples', and hence 'of' is appropriate.
 
• "Of passages and there precis": 'There' is incorrect in this context. 'Their' should be used as a possessive pronoun referring to 'examples'.
 
• "Of passages and there precises": Here again, 'there' is incorrect. Also, 'precises' is not the correct form of the word. The correct word is 'precis', whether in singular or plural.
 
• **"No substitution":** This means the underlined portion is already perfect and requires no change.
 
 
 
• Given the context of the sentence and the alternatives provided, it seems that the underlined phrase **"of passages and their precis" **is **correct **as is, and does not require any substitution.
 
• Thus the correct option is **'No substitution'. **
 
• The term **'precis' **is a concise summary of an article or speech, and **'their' **is correctly used as a possessive adjective referring back to 'examples'.
 
• The original sentence is correct grammatically and contextually.

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 4". **

questions.question:
**The question below consists of a set of labeled sentences. Out of the four options given, select the most logical order of the sentences to form a coherent paragraph.**

P. As a boy Elon was a keen reader and learnt how to code computers.

Q. He even made his own video game called Blastar.

R. Later he moved to Canada and then the United States setting up his first company with his brother Kimbal in 1995.

S. But after some time, he sold that company to create a company called X.com.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** PQRS**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** sentence P** is the first sentence which introduces a boy named Elon.
 
• The second sentence should be **sentence Q** which gives more information about the boy that he also made his own video game.
 
• **Sentence R** should be the third sentence which says that after sometime Elon moved to Canada and the United States where he set up his first company.
 
• **Sentence S** should be the last sentence which says that the company was sold by him later. 
 
• Thus, the most logical order of the sentences to form a coherent paragraph is **option 4.** 

**Correct Sequence:**__ ***P.** As a boy Elon was a keen reader and learnt how to code computers. **Q. **He even made his own video game called Blastar.** R.** Later he moved to Canada and then the United States setting up his first company with his brother Kimbal in 1995. **S.** But after some time, he sold that company to create a company called X.com.*
